_readme: Added by the ita slice worker (#467) from ita_for_eng fix records and the Italian canon entries (K33-K44, P27, P28). kp = PRE-FIX ita_for_eng text (or the canon's own example) the regex must match. Merge into patterns.json under 'ita' / 'known:eng'. A hit is a candidate to read, never a defect.

ita.kp: ha detto che poteva girare a sinistra se volesse

K44: chiedere una domanda 'non si dice' (job #345, d/f76d2340)
K40: bare complementiser is not the trigger; S0655L01 'that you're doing | che stia andando' named as the violation. Read LEGO hits only.
#427/#435: S0597L04U04 c'erano (no LEGO teaches it) → ho visto cento persone; c'è is taught at S0436L01 only
